prompt: The man walks in place away from the camera, as if on a treadmill, seen from behind, with a brisk, steady, continuous walking rhythm at a normal city pace, like a man who is cold and wants to get somewhere: no pause between the steps, one foot is always moving; legs stepping and arms swinging in alternation, bag swaying slightly. He stays in exactly the same spot and at the same size in the centre of the frame and keeps his back to the viewer. Seamless loop. The camera is completely static: no pan, no zoom, no camera shake. He wears the same closed grey winter coat and mustard-yellow scarf the whole time.
